_notes: MMSI research pass for aisstream.io subscription. Sources: vesselfinder.com and marinetraffic.com listings surfaced via Google search snippets (direct site fetches were blocked by robots.txt/provenance). Most charter boats under 65' are not required to carry AIS Class A and legitimately have no MMSI. Party boats (Big Jamaica 125', Paramount 100', Miss Barnegat Light, The Gambler 125') and the 60'+ sportfishing operations were the most productive. Six high/medium confidence MMSIs found; the rest are legitimately not_found (small boats without AIS) or ambiguous common-name vessels. Recommend the main session review MEDIUM confidence entries before adding them to captain_vessels.json — if wrong they would track the wrong boat.
